user.title: Connect Linkivi
user.description: Create an API key with the "Home Assistant" template in Linkivi (Settings › Developers). The Pro plan is required.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The Linkivi key was revoked or has expired. Paste a new one ("Home Assistant" template).

error.cannot_connect: Linkivi cannot be reached at this address.
error.invalid_auth: Key refused: check that it is active, uses the "Home Assistant" template and that the organisation is on the Pro plan.

show_message.name: Show a message
show_message.description: Shows a message over the playlist of the chosen screens, then goes back to the playlist. The screen must be online and awake (or woken by the action). Pro plan.

title.name: Title
title.description: Up to 60 characters. Title or message required.

wake.name: Wake the screen
wake.description: Wakes a sleeping screen for the length of the message (otherwise a sleeping screen refuses).

place.name: Place
place.description: Full screen, or the banner cell that receives messages (full screen if the screen has none).

clear_display.name: Stop the display
clear_display.description: Removes the message: the playlist resumes at once.
